verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS feedback and support platform with a public API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents webhooks, SDKs and APIs but never mentions a sandbox, test mode or isolated non-production environment. Webhook signature verification and retries are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
